projects.title: Currency CLI
projects.short-description: A small command-line tool that shows the current exchange rate of USD or EUR to BRL, using the AwesomeAPI. I made this because I was tired of checking USD values lots of times everyday on Google. Now I just type 'currency USD' a few times a day :).
